'''Carlya''' is the name of [[Elaida]]'s maid. 

When Elaida is taken by the [[Seanchan]] and feels the air, her first thought is to blame Carlya for not shutting the window properly.

[[Elayne]] uses a similar alias "Mistress Caryla" aboard the ''[[Darter]]'' and whilst in [[Tear]].{{ref/book|3|48}}
